verdict.rationale: Cognee's MCP role is as an MCP *server* — AI assistants like Claude, Cursor, and Cline connect to Cognee to use its memory tools (cognee-docs-6, cognee-docs-21, cognee-docs-34, cognee-docs-42). There is no evidence Cognee itself acts as an MCP client that plugs into and consumes external MCP servers' tools, and given its role as a memory backend consumed by agents (not itself an agent orchestrating external tools), this client-side axis is a category mismatch rather than a gap.
